subject: [PATCH 37/60] mm/page_alloc: keep private memory out of reclaim reserves

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author posted the original patch and a duplicate message, but no discussion or review has occurred yet.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the page allocation algorithm to exclude private memory from reclaim reserves, ensuring that general system allocations are not affected by private node reservations.
